models.purpose: Model continuous hot-water addition and the bath temperature field
models.summary: A rectangular bathwater domain uses incompressible-flow, momentum, and energy equations with inlet, free-surface, and wall boundary conditions.

governing_equations.normalized_latex: \frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+\frac{\partial w}{\partial z}=0

governing_equations.source_expression: rho(u du/dx+v du/dy+w du/dz)=-dp/dx+mu Laplacian u
governing_equations.normalized_latex: \rho\left(u\frac{\partial u}{\partial x}+v\frac{\partial u}{\partial y}+w\frac{\partial u}{\partial z}\right)=-\frac{\partial p}{\partial x}+\mu\nabla^2u
\rho\left(u\frac{\partial v}{\partial x}+v\frac{\partial v}{\partial y}+w\frac{\partial v}{\partial z}\right)=-\frac{\partial p}{\partial y}+\mu\nabla^2v

governing_equations.source_expression: rho(u dw/dx+v dw/dy+w dw/dz)=-rho g+mu Laplacian w
governing_equations.normalized_latex: \rho\left(u\frac{\partial w}{\partial x}+v\frac{\partial w}{\partial y}+w\frac{\partial w}{\partial z}\right)=-\rho g+\mu\nabla^2w

governing_equations.source_expression: rho cp(u dt/dx+v dt/dy+w dt/dz)=k Laplacian t
governing_equations.normalized_latex: \rho c_p\left(u\frac{\partial t}{\partial x}+v\frac{\partial t}{\partial y}+w\frac{\partial t}{\partial z}\right)=k\nabla^2t
